name: How does Kelby Contreras re-market an expired luxury property?

mainEntity.name: How does Kelby Contreras re-market an expired luxury property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kelby Contreras re-markets expired luxury properties by developing a bespoke strategy that often includes professional staging, high-quality photography and videography, targeted digital advertising to affluent buyers, and exclusive networking within the luxury real estate community. We focus on highlighting unique features and lifestyle benefits relevant to areas like Fisher Island or Key Biscayne. Process clarity involves an initial property assessment followed by a detailed marketing plan tailored to its specific needs.
